sleep.title: Hampton by Hilton
sleep.text: Hampton by Hilton Urumqi International Airport is at 5 Silk Road Global Harbor Phase II, 2888 Beijing N Rd, Xinshi District. Guests receive free hot breakfast, Wi-Fi and parking; there is a restaurant and fitness centre. Check-in starts at 14:00 and check-out is by 12:00; phone: +86 991 3535555.
